sections.title: Explanation
sections.content: *Hová*? asks where someone is going. Use a destination form with movement verbs such as *megy* and jön.

items.english: Károly is going to the shop.

sections.content: Notice the destination phrase sits right before the verb — Károly a boltba megy, not ‘Károly megy a boltba’ — mirroring the Hol? + van pattern you already know: place-word first, verb last. That’s not a coincidence; Hungarian consistently likes its verb to land at the end of a simple statement.
